bifrost: bifrost_app::attributed, bifrost_app::spellcheck, bifrost_ui::text, bifrost_ui::textfit, bifrost_ui::panels, render font engine
summary: Attributed strings, a rich text editing model, spell checking, a text editing and IME model, line breaking, a font panel and a font renderer exist. There is no multi-line text view widget, no TextKit layout manager and no Writing Tools.

features.feature: Text Display: attributed strings and rich text
features.note: Runs, RTF and HTML round trips, accessibility runs in UTF-16 units and rich text typing and undo are tested headless in parity_sdk-tests-11.rs and attributed::tests. Gap: no paragraph styles, text attachments, lists or tables in this model (the ui layer has them per paragraph in text_layout_manager.rs, not yet carried by bifrost_app::attributed), and rich text drawing has no pixel test.

features.feature: Text Display: single-line text field and editing model
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/text.rs (TextBuffer, TextEditor, marked text, grapheme movement, undo); docs/bifrost-ui.md 'Text input client'
features.note: editing commands, IME composition and key bindings covered

features.feature: Text Display: multi-line text view widget
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/textview.rs; wired: springboard/apps/voicememos-desktop/src/voicememos.rs (notes card: draw_notes, notes_key, notes_place) on bifrost_app::controls::textview::TextView; sidecar in src/store.rs; springboard/ui/src/text_layout_manager.rs (layout, selection navigation); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs
features.note: TextView adds isRichText, allowsUndo, usesFindBar, incremental find, next, previous, replace and replace all (one undo step), and a spelling hook; typing coalesces into one undo step. Host unit and integration tests (springboard/ui/tests/text_view.rs) cover those, and ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-06.rs headless tests cover wrapping, line lookup, hit testing, goal columns, highlights, scrolling to the caret and the find bar flags. Not yet drawn by a shell widget or checked on Midget, so the row stays partial.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (tokenizer, pluggable Dictionary, learned and ignored words); wired: springboard/core/src/spellcheck.rs (model, moved from sdk); springboard/sdk/src/spellcheck.rs (SDK re-export); springboard/src/shell/services/text_services.rs (shell service `text`); springboard/sdk/src/text_services.rs (client); springboard/apps/textedit-desktop/src/spell.rs over bifrost_app::spellcheck
features.note: The tokenizer, the pluggable dictionary, learned and ignored words and the checks are tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-02.rs (spelling module, through the SDK re-export). Gaps: no system-wide spelling panel or autocorrect UI in text views; wired into TextEdit in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39), not yet verified on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/detect.rs; wired: springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/notes.rs (uses springboard/ui/src/detect.rs Kind::Address; editor row FillAddress in src/calendar.rs); wired: springboard/apps/calendar-desktop/src/calendar/notes.rs (address, phone) over springboard/ui/src/detect.rs
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. link, date and phone detection only as documented in bifrost-ui.md Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.

features.feature: Text Display: line breaking and truncation
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 21 tests. head, middle, tail truncation and wrapping; no tab stops, indents or hyphenation

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 3 tests. Wave 5 (theme-03, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no glyph-level layout API for apps; layout is per widget

features.feature: TextKit: custom layout, text attachments, text lists, find bar
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/textfind.rs, springboard/ui/src/textlist.rs; wired: springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/mod.rs (start_replacing, replace_one, replace_all, draw_replacing); springboard/apps/notes-desktop/src/notes/parity.rs (find_ranges, replace_ranges)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 14 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. family, style and size only; no collections, effects or typography panes

TrueType, CFF and variable fonts render, and the font object, metrics, glyph map, cascade and manager behind them are tested headless. Gap: the engine's output is not compared with the reference on the lab machine.

Settings > Fonts replaces the system and mono fonts with a face from BifrOSt's font library. The choice, the library listing and resolution are tested headless in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-10-fonts-w7.rs (font_descriptor tests). Not yet wired into apps or the shell, and not yet tested on the VM or Midget.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 2 (theme-14, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Assistant app exists but gives text views no rewrite or proofread hook

gaps: Multi-line text view widget (NSTextView) (model, find bar and layout exist; no shell widget draws them yet)
TextKit layout manager and text containers (layout manager exists on the ui layer; no glyph generation, no custom fragment providers)
Paragraph styles, text lists, tables and attachments in attributed text (modelled in bifrost-ui; attributed strings in the SDK do not carry them yet)
Writing Tools integration for text views
Text finder (find bar) (find bar model and view wiring exist; no drawn find bar, no regex)
Font collections and full NSFontDescriptor attributes. sdk font_descriptor.rs (UserFonts) covers only the Settings font choice.
